Enable LRC activity signals for Preview and Dogfood (#16578)

## Description
Enable long-running command activity sampling in Preview, so silent but
active commands provide liveness evidence before cancellation. Dogfood
inherits Preview flags; Stable defaults remain unchanged.

Companion server gate:
https://github.com/warpdotdev/warp-server/pull/20338.
